question_text: Under which FDA risk category is the primary medical device classified (Class I, Class II, or Class III)?
remediation_action: Determine classification to route conditional regulatory pathways.

question_text: Has the facility completed its annual FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing?
remediation_action: Submit FDA Form 2891 and 2892 prior to commercial distribution.

question_text: Is the Quality Management System (QMS) fully documented and compliant with the FDA QMSR and ISO 13485:2016 standards (effective Feb 2026)?
remediation_action: Transition QMS documentation from legacy QSR to ISO 13485:2016 framework.

question_text: Are Design Controls properly maintained in the Design History File (DHF), mapping user needs to validated design outputs?
remediation_action: Audit DHF for complete traceability matrices and design validation records.

question_text: Has a comprehensive risk management file been established in accordance with ISO 14971?
remediation_action: Perform and document a formal hazard analysis and FMEA.

question_text: Does the medical device contain software, connect to the internet, or qualify as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)?
remediation_action: Trigger FDA Premarket Cybersecurity Guidance compliance pathways.

question_text: Has a Secure Product Development Framework (SPDF) been implemented and integrated into the QMS?
remediation_action: Align software lifecycle processes with IEC 81001-5-1 standards.

question_text: Is a machine-readable Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) available in SPDX or CycloneDX format, compliant with FD&C Act §524B?
remediation_action: Generate automated SBOMs during the software build process.

question_text: Has formal threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) been conducted, linking identified threats to specific risk controls?
remediation_action: Execute threat modeling mapping entry points, trust boundaries, and attack paths.

question_text: Is there a documented postmarket vulnerability management plan outlining patch deployment SLAs?
remediation_action: Define triage criteria and OTA (Over-The-Air) secure update mechanisms.

question_text: Has the company secured active FDA 510(k) clearance, and is the substantial equivalence documentation for the predicate device available?
remediation_action: Prepare 510(k) premarket notification or De Novo classification request.

question_text: Has the FDA granted Premarket Approval (PMA) for this device?
remediation_action: Suspend commercial distribution and submit comprehensive PMA dossier.

question_text: Are all human clinical trial results compliant with 21 CFR Part 812 (IDE) and supported by Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals?
remediation_action: Audit the Trial Master File (TMF) for Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance.

question_text: Are outsourced processes and critical component suppliers governed by written Quality Agreements?
remediation_action: Execute formal Quality Agreements specifying notification requirements for process changes.

question_text: Are Device Master Records (DMR) and Device History Records (DHR) maintained to prove products are manufactured to approved specifications?
remediation_action: Digitize and audit batch records and DHRs for signature completeness.

question_text: Does the device label bear a Unique Device Identifier (UDI) in both human-readable and machine-readable form?
remediation_action: Integrate UDI barcoding into the packaging and submit data to the GUDID database.

question_text: Does the company maintain documented Medical Device Reporting (MDR) procedures for adverse events within 30 days?
remediation_action: Implement compliant MDR adverse event evaluation and reporting workflows.

question_text: Is a robust Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) system actively utilized to investigate and resolve nonconformities?
remediation_action: Audit CAPA logs for timely effectiveness checks and root cause analysis documentation.

question_text: Are all promotional materials and Instructions for Use (IFU) strictly aligned with the FDA-cleared indications for use?
remediation_action: Conduct a regulatory review of all marketing assets to eliminate off-label claims.

question_text: If manufactured internationally, does the importer of record hold appropriate FDA registration and comply with CBP requirements?
remediation_action: Verify importer registration status and secure necessary Certificates to Foreign Government (CFG).
